description.value: Fruitvale Co-op is a locally-owned member cooperative that has served the Fruitvale and Slocan Valley communities for over 90 years. Operating under the Federated Co-operatives banner, it combines convenience grocery shopping with fuel services at a single Main Street location. A touring cyclist passing through this small Kootenay community will find this one of the more complete resupply stops in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is 'Fruitvale Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative serving Fruitvale,' matching the OSM brand (Federated Co-operatives) and location. The OSM tags shop=convenience and amenity=fuel indicate a combined convenience/grocery and fuel stop; the website's mention of 'Fuel Good Day' corroborates the fuel component. The website content is very sparse (CMS rendering artifacts dominate) so most amenity fields cannot be confirmed beyond what the OSM tags and brand imply.
concerns: OSM name is 'Co-op' but the website and brand identity use 'Fruitvale Co-op'; OSM name stored as-is per rules.
Website content is heavily obscured by CMS template artifacts (${title}, ${loading} placeholders), limiting amenity verification to OSM tags and brand inference only.

OSM tags both shop=convenience and amenity=fuel — this appears to be a combined fuel station and convenience/grocery store; the Groceries category is reasonable but the fuel component is equally prominent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible co-operative grocery and fuel stop in a small Kootenay community; a practical resupply point for touring cyclists on this route.
